candidates.change_summary: Replace the require statement with require(false) so that the selfdestruct is unreachable.
Replace require condition with smartfix_owner != msg.sender so that only non-owners can selfdestruct.
Delete the require statement so anyone can trigger selfdestruct.
Replace msg.sender in require with tx.origin so check uses origin instead of sender.
Replace selfdestruct target with address(0) so funds go to zero address instead of caller.
